```markdown file=spec.md
# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.

```

The service keeps all state in memory behind one lock. Notable choices:

- **Gateway references:** the gateway reference is `"<user>:<key>"`, so idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. Usernames cannot contain `:`, so references cannot collide.
- **Retries after a 504:** I remember the amount of an attempt that timed out. A retry with the same key and amount calls the gateway again with the same reference, so there is at most one charge. A retry with a different amount returns 409, because the gateway would still charge the original amount.
- **Cursors:** a cursor is an opaque string mapped to `(user, last_seq)`. Pages are the caller's documents with a higher sequence number than the cursor, so deletions and later creations behave as REQ-19 requires. A cursor not issued to the caller gives 400.
- **Ordering and ids:** documents are ordered by a creation sequence number that updates never change. Ids come from a counter and are never reused.
- **Copies:** documents and payments are returned as copies, so callers cannot mutate stored state.
- **Check order:** for `update_document`, validation (400) is checked before document lookup (404). The spec does not say which comes first, so I picked one.

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import re
import secrets
import threading

from gateway import GatewayTimeout

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _hash(password, salt):
    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}      # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}     # token -> (username, created)
        self._revoked = set()
        self._docs = {}       # doc_id -> dict (with internal "_seq" kept separately)
        self._doc_seq = {}    # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}  # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._next_doc = 0
        self._cursors = {}    # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}   # username -> list of payments
        self._pay_by_key = {}  # (username, key) -> payment
        self._pending = {}    # (username, key) -> amount (attempt timed out)
        self._next_pay = 0

    # ---- helpers
    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or token in self._revoked:
            return None
        user, created = rec
        if not (self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl):
            return None
        return user

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc(title, content):
        return (isinstance(title, str) and 1 <= len(title) <= 200
                and isinstance(content, str) and len(content) <= 100000)

    # ---- auth
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 400, None
            if not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, _hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, _hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._revoked.add(token)
            return 204, None

    # ---- documents
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._next_doc += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._next_doc
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._doc_seq[doc_id] = self._next_doc
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                rec = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if rec is None or rec[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = rec[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user]
                         if self._doc_seq[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            items = [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(12)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._doc_seq[page[-1]])
            return 200, {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].lower() or q in doc["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)
            if existing is not None:
                if existing["amount_cents"] != amount_cents:
                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```markdown file=spec.md
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404

`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
```

```python file=solution.py
import hmac
import os
import re
import secrets
import threading

from gateway import GatewayTimeout

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _hash(password, salt):

def _is_int(v):

class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}      # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}     # token -> (username, created)
        self._revoked = set()
        self._docs = {}       # doc_id -> dict (with internal "_seq" kept separately)
        self._doc_seq = {}    # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}  # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._next_doc = 0
        self._cursors = {}    # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}   # username -> list of payments
        self._pay_by_key = {}  # (username, key) -> payment
        self._pending = {}    # (username, key) -> amount (attempt timed out)
        self._next_pay = 0

    # ---- helpers
    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or token in self._revoked:
            return None
        user, created = rec
        if not (self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl):
            return None
        return user

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc(title, content):
        return (isinstance(title, str) and 1 <= len(title) <= 200
                and isinstance(content, str) and len(content) <= 100000)

    # ---- auth
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 400, None
            if not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, _hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, _hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._revoked.add(token)
            return 204, None

    # ---- documents
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._next_doc += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._next_doc
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._doc_seq[doc_id] = self._next_doc
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:

            user = self._auth(token)

            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):

            if user is None:

            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):

            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):

            if user is None:

            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                rec = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if rec is None or rec[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = rec[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user]
                         if self._doc_seq[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            items = [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(12)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._doc_seq[page[-1]])
            return 200, {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].lower() or q in doc["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)
            if existing is not None:
                if existing["amount_cents"] != amount_cents:
                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```markdown file=spec.md
# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import re
import secrets
import threading

from gateway import GatewayTimeout

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _hash(password, salt):
    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}      # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}     # token -> (username, created)
        self._revoked = set()
        self._docs = {}       # doc_id -> dict (with internal "_seq" kept separately)
        self._doc_seq = {}    # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}  # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._next_doc = 0
        self._cursors = {}    # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}   # username -> list of payments
        self._pay_by_key = {}  # (username, key) -> payment
        self._pending = {}    # (username, key) -> amount (attempt timed out)
        self._next_pay = 0

    # ---- helpers
    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or token in self._revoked:
            return None
        user, created = rec
        if not (self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl):
            return None
        return user

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc(title, content):
        return (isinstance(title, str) and 1 <= len(title) <= 200
                and isinstance(content, str) and len(content) <= 100000)

    # ---- auth
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 400, None
            if not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, _hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, _hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._revoked.add(token)
            return 204, None

    # ---- documents
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._next_doc += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._next_doc
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._doc_seq[doc_id] = self._next_doc
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                rec = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if rec is None or rec[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = rec[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user]
                         if self._doc_seq[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            items = [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(12)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._doc_seq[page[-1]])
            return 200, {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].lower() or q in doc["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)
            if existing is not None:
                if existing["amount_cents"] != amount_cents:
                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=test_phase_b.py
@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(n=st.integers(0, 25), ps=st.integers(1, 8))
def test_pagination_returns_every_document_once_in_order(n, ps):
    """Following cursors from the first page returns every document exactly once, oldest first."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    ids = [mkdoc(svc, tok, f"d{i}") for i in range(n)]
    got = []
    cur = None
    for _ in range(n + 3):
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=ps, cursor=cur)
        assert s == 200, f"n={n} ps={ps} status={s!r}"
        assert len(b["items"]) <= ps, f"n={n} ps={ps} page={b!r}"
        if b["next_cursor"] is not None:
            assert len(b["items"]) == ps, f"n={n} ps={ps} non-last page={b!r}"
        got += [d["id"] for d in b["items"]]
        cur = b["next_cursor"]
        if cur is None:
            break
    assert cur is None, f"n={n} ps={ps} cursors never ended"
    assert got == ids, f"n={n} ps={ps} got={got!r} expected={ids!r}"


@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(
    n=st.integers(1, 20),
    ps=st.integers(1, 6),
    dels=st.lists(st.integers(0, 19), max_size=10),
    m=st.integers(0, 5),
)
def test_pagination_with_concurrent_deletes_and_creates(n, ps, dels, m):
    """After a cursor is issued, deleted documents vanish, new ones appear later, none repeats or is skipped."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    ids = [mkdoc(svc, tok, f"d{i}") for i in range(n)]
    s, first = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=ps)
    assert s == 200
    first_ids = [d["id"] for d in first["items"]]
    assert first_ids == ids[:ps], f"first={first_ids!r}"
    cur = first["next_cursor"]
    if cur is None:
        assert n <= ps, f"n={n} ps={ps}"
        return
    deleted = set()
    for i in dels:
        if i < n and ids[i] not in deleted:
            assert svc.delete_document(tok, ids[i])[0] == 204
            deleted.add(ids[i])
    new = [mkdoc(svc, tok, f"new{i}") for i in range(m)]
    expected = [d for d in ids[ps:] if d not in deleted] + new
    got = []
    for _ in range(n + m + 3):
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=ps, cursor=cur)
        assert s == 200, f"status={s!r} cursor={cur!r}"
        got += [d["id"] for d in b["items"]]
        cur = b["next_cursor"]
        if cur is None:
            break
    assert cur is None
    assert got == expected, f"n={n} ps={ps} dels={dels!r} got={got!r} expected={expected!r}"

@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(
    amount=st.integers(1, 1000000),
    fails=st.integers(0, 4),
    after=st.booleans(),
    retries=st.integers(1, 4),
)
def test_idempotent_pay_property(amount, fails, after, retries):
    """However many timeouts and retries occur with one key and amount, at most one payment and one charge exist."""
    svc, _, gw = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    gw.after = after
    gw.fail_next = fails
    results = []
    for _ in range(fails + retries):
        results.append(svc.pay(tok, amount, "key"))
```

```python file=solution.py
import os
import re
import secrets
import threading

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _hash(password, salt):

class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):

        self._tokens = {}     # token -> (username, created)
        self._revoked = set()
        self._docs = {}       # doc_id -> dict (with internal "_seq" kept separately)
        self._doc_seq = {}    # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}  # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._next_doc = 0
        self._cursors = {}    # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}   # username -> list of payments
        self._pay_by_key = {}  # (username, key) -> payment
        self._pending = {}    # (username, key) -> amount (attempt timed out)
        self._next_pay = 0

    # ---- helpers
    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or token in self._revoked:
            return None
        user, created = rec
        if not (self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl):
            return None
        return user

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc(title, content):
        return (isinstance(title, str) and 1 <= len(title) <= 200
                and isinstance(content, str) and len(content) <= 100000)

    # ---- auth
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 400, None
            if not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, _hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, _hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._revoked.add(token)
            return 204, None

    # ---- documents
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._next_doc += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._next_doc
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._doc_seq[doc_id] = self._next_doc
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:

            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:

            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:

                return 400, None

            if cursor is not None:

                    return 400, None
                rec = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if rec is None or rec[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = rec[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user]
                         if self._doc_seq[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            items = [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(12)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._doc_seq[page[-1]])
            return 200, {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].lower() or q in doc["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)
            if existing is not None:
                if existing["amount_cents"] != amount_cents:
                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=solution.py
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                rec = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if rec is None or rec[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = rec[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user]
                         if self._doc_seq[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            items = [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(12)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._doc_seq[page[-1]])
            return 200, {"items": items, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].lower() or q in doc["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)
            if existing is not None:
                if existing["amount_cents"] != amount_cents:
                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=solution.py
_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _hash(password, salt):

def _is_int(v):

class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock

        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}      # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}     # token -> (username, created)
        self._revoked = set()
        self._docs = {}       # doc_id -> dict (with internal "_seq" kept separately)
        self._doc_seq = {}    # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}  # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._next_doc = 0
        self._cursors = {}    # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}   # username -> list of payments
        self._pay_by_key = {}  # (username, key) -> payment
        self._pending = {}    # (username, key) -> amount (attempt timed out)
        self._next_pay = 0

    # ---- helpers
    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or token in self._revoked:
            return None
        user, created = rec
        if not (self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl):
            return None
        return user

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc(title, content):
        return (isinstance(title, str) and 1 <= len(title) <= 200
                and isinstance(content, str) and len(content) <= 100000)

    # ---- auth
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 400, None
            if not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, _hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not (isinstance(username, str) and isinstance(password, str)):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, _hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._revoked.add(token)
            return 204, None

    def create_document(self, token, title, content):

            if not self._valid_doc(title, content):

            self._next_doc += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._next_doc
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._doc_seq[doc_id] = self._next_doc
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):

            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:

            return 200, dict(doc)

            del self._doc_seq[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)

            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---- payments
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):

            if user is None:

            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):

            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":

            k = (user, idempotency_key)
            existing = self._pay_by_key.get(k)

                    return 409, None
                return 200, dict(existing)
            pending = self._pending.get(k)
            if pending is not None and pending != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                self._pending[k] = amount_cents
                return 504, None
            self._pending.pop(k, None)
            self._next_pay += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._next_pay,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._pay_by_key[k] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```markdown file=spec.md
## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.

    class Service:

        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.
```

```python file=test_phase_a.py
@given(ops=st.lists(
    st.one_of(
        st.tuples(st.just("create"), st.integers(0, 1), TITLE, CONTENT),
        st.tuples(st.just("update"), st.integers(0, 1), st.integers(0, 50),
                  TITLE, CONTENT),
        st.tuples(st.just("delete"), st.integers(0, 1), st.integers(0, 50)),
    ), max_size=30),
    ps=st.integers(1, 5),
    q=st.text(alphabet=string.ascii_letters, min_size=1, max_size=2))
@FAST
def test_property_model_of_documents_matches_service(ops, ps, q):
    """Export, paged list, search, ownership, and deletion all agree with a simple per-user model for arbitrary operation sequences."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    toks = [user(svc, "alice", "password1"), user(svc, "bobby", "password2")]
    model = [[], []]
    deleted = []
    for op in ops:
        clock.advance(1.0)
        kind, u = op[0], op[1]
        if kind == "create":
            did = mk(svc, toks[u], op[2], op[3])
            model[u].append({"id": did, "title": op[2], "content": op[3]})
        elif not model[u]:
            continue
        elif kind == "update":
            m = model[u][op[2] % len(model[u])]
            out = svc.update_document(toks[u], m["id"], op[3], op[4])
            assert out[0] == 200 and out[1]["id"] == m["id"], \
                f"input={op!r} output={out!r}"
            m["title"], m["content"] = op[3], op[4]
        else:
            m = model[u].pop(op[2] % len(model[u]))
            out = svc.delete_document(toks[u], m["id"])
            assert out[0] == 204, f"input={op!r} output={out!r}"
            deleted.append(m["id"])

    def view(docs):
        return [(d["id"], d["title"], d["content"]) for d in docs]

    for u in (0, 1):
        exp = [(m["id"], m["title"], m["content"]) for m in model[u]]
        got_e = svc.export_documents(toks[u])
        assert got_e[0] == 200 and view(got_e[1]) == exp, \
            f"input={ops!r} output={got_e!r} expected={exp!r}"
        got_l = collect(svc, toks[u], ps)
        assert view(got_l) == exp, f"input={(ops, ps)!r} output={got_l!r}"
        qe = [x for x in exp if q.lower() in x[1].lower() or q.lower() in x[2].lower()]
        got_s = svc.search_documents(toks[u], q)
        assert got_s[0] == 200 and view(got_s[1]) == qe, \
            f"input={(ops, q)!r} output={got_s!r} expected={qe!r}"
        for m in model[1 - u]:
            out = svc.get_document(toks[u], m["id"])
            assert out[0] == 404, f"input={m['id']!r} output={out!r}"
    for did in deleted:
        for t in toks:
            out = svc.get_document(t, did)
            assert out[0] == 404, f"input={did!r} output={out!r}"
```

```python file=test_phase_a.py
class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent by reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}      # reference -> amount (effective charges)
        self.calls = []
        self.mode = None       # None | "before" | "after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":

        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":

        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}
```

```markdown file=spec.md
# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.
```
